Add it to F-Droid

  1. Open F-Droid (or Droid-ify / Neo Store) → Settings → Repositories.
  2. Tap + and paste the repo address above.
  3. Go to the Latest tab, search for Doomscroll, and install.

Verify the fingerprint shown by the client matches the one above. After the first add, updates arrive automatically — no more manual APK downloads.

Good to know

  • This repo is run by the app's developer, not by F-Droid. It is not reviewed by F-Droid.
  • APKs are signed with the project release key, so updates from this repo and from GitHub Releases are interchangeable — no uninstall needed.
  • An official F-Droid listing (once available) uses F-Droid's key; switching to that build requires uninstalling this one.
